title: Fast of the Prophets / Advent Fast
description: A preparatory fast before the Nativity, marked by waiting for the Incarnation.

title: Fast of the Dormition
description: A Marian fast honoring the Dormition and Assumption of Saint Mary.

title: Fast of the Apostles
start_rule: Begins the day after Pentecost and ends on Hamle 5
description: A fast honoring the apostolic witness after Pentecost.

title: Vigil Fast
start_rule: Observed on feast eves such as Lidet and Timket
description: A vigil fast kept on the eve of major feasts such as Nativity and Epiphany.

title: Wednesday Fast
description: Weekly fasting discipline. Not a Synaxarium feast/commemoration by itself.

title: Friday Fast
description: Weekly fasting discipline. Not a Synaxarium feast/commemoration by itself.
